parameters.query: SELECT json_build_object('collected_mtd',(SELECT COALESCE(round(sum(amount)),0) FROM xero.payment WHERE payment_type='ACCRECPAYMENT' AND status='AUTHORISED' AND date_trunc('month',date)=date_trunc('month',current_date)),'collected_7d',(SELECT COALESCE(round(sum(amount)),0) FROM xero.payment WHERE payment_type='ACCRECPAYMENT' AND status='AUTHORISED' AND date>=current_date-7),'outstanding',(SELECT COALESCE(round(sum(amount_due)),0) FROM xero.invoice WHERE type='ACCREC' AND status='AUTHORISED'),'outstanding_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM xero.invoice WHERE type='ACCREC' AND status='AUTHORISED' AND amount_due>0),'overdue',(SELECT COALESCE(round(sum(amount_due)),0) FROM xero.invoice WHERE type='ACCREC' AND status='AUTHORISED' AND due_date<current_date AND amount_due>0),'overdue_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM xero.invoice WHERE type='ACCREC' AND status='AUTHORISED' AND due_date<current_date AND amount_due>0),'followers',(SELECT sum(followers) FROM content_perf.metricool_snapshots WHERE page<>'Koocester' AND snapshot_date=(SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM content_perf.metricool_snapshots))) AS payload
